notes.title: Automata Ecosystem is out NOW!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42316365/1eec92400b101876b1900be742e27f456aed2120.png[/img]

Hello!

It's finally time to release Automata Ecosystem, I really hope you enjoy the game, at least a fraction of how much I enjoyed making it! I hope you will be interested in the project, and to be able to update it with even more simulation features, so stay tuned for more info.

And if you get creative, send me your ecosystems on [url=https://discord.gg/fu5uqHnCYm]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/glitched_code]Twitter[/url], let's see what YOU can come up with!

Have fun!

-Peppe

notes.title: Automata Ecosystem releases on May 31!
notes.content:
Hi there!
I'm Peppe, checking in to tell you that Automata Ecosyystem is ready for release!
The game will be available for purchase on May 31 with a small discount for early customers, but if you want another peek at what the simulation can do, you can check out my latest trailer. :D

[previewyoutube=zdh29PkyzoE;full][/previewyoutube]

Going forward, the project may see some updates, depending on player interest and the amount of free time I have, so stay tuned if you want to see more!!
